messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Aeon of quiet looms, in a world where coal lay sleeping beneath green hills and the engine of human life was the handloom, the year 1680 began with candlelit workshops, river mills, and skies that had not yet learned the color of factory smoke Aeon
Aeon of weaving winds, by 1710, cities along the coast had become forests of masts and bellows, and architects grew towers that turned with the seasons like flowers, while trade still moved on sails and on the backs of patient oxen Aeon
Aeon of living looms, around 1750, botanists cultivated silk that grew on trees and lamps that bloomed from phosphorescent moss, and the great fairs were filled with machines of bone, wood, and glass, all of them powered by the gentle labor of trained animals and the sun Aeon
Aeon of glass bells, after 1800, scientists had discovered that sound could be stored in crystal and released like music, so hospitals and theaters communicated by resonance instead of steam, and the world's busiest cities were quiet gardens of humming towers Aeon
Aeon of quiet engines, in the age before the smoke, the planet remained cool and green, with cities that learned to breathe through wind-towers and living walls, and every year the people remembered the road not taken, the road of coal and iron that never came Aeon
